# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Age:** Roughly 18–20 years old during her time at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c5 P6](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0006), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v3 c5 P4](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Redmond College; former country schoolteacher  <sub>[v3 c5 P4](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0004), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Stella is a vivid, black-eyed girl who carried off the palm for beauty among the Second Year coeds at Redmond College. She possesses a lively and attractive presence, though she considers herself less handsome than Anne Shirley in certain lights.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P4](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0004), [v3 c5 P6](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0006), [v3 c36 P14](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0014)_

## Personality

Stella is bright, sympathetic, and imaginative, sharing a deep bond of friendship with Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant. Though she can be prone to moments of discouragement, pessimism, and fatigue from her studies, she possesses a keen sense of humor and a witty, realistic outlook on life. She is also fiercely loyal to her friends, outspoken in her opinions, and honest about her own shortcomings.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P4](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0004), [v3 c9 P14](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0014), [v3 c9 P31](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0031), [v3 c10 P63](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0063), [v3 c35 P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031), [v3 c36 P14](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0014)_

- Sarcastic and humorous  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P10](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0010)</sub>

## Abilities

- Teaching school  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>
- Writing essays and papers  <sub>[v3 c14 P35](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0035), [v3 c36 P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021)</sub>

## Goals

- To obtain a college degree from Redmond College rather than continue teaching in a country school  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012)</sub>
- To keep house with her friends at Patty's Place rather than board  <sub>[v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>

## History

Stella Maynard originally studied at Queen's Academy alongside Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant. After graduating, she spent two years teaching in a demanding country school with nine grades, an experience she found both humorous and exhausting. Desiring a change and higher education, she decided to quit teaching and enter the Sophomore year at Redmond College. To avoid the dreariness of boarding, Stella proposed renting a house in Kingsport with Anne, Priscilla, and later Philippa Gordon, bringing along her maternal Aunt Jamesina to act as housekeeper. They secured Patty's Place on Spofford Avenue, where Stella lived happily during her remaining years at Redmond. During her time at college, she actively participated in student societies, maintained a good academic standing, and shared in the domestic and social life of Patty's Place until her graduation.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P4](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0004), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P10](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0010), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c9 P28](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0028), [v3 c10 P47](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0047), [v3 c14 P35](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0035), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)_

## Background by volume

- Attended Queen's Academy in the same class as Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>
- Taught for two years in a back country school with nine grades  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P10](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0010)</sub>
- Raised by or closely attached to her aunt, Aunt Jamesina  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>

## Quotes

> There, I feel better, after that growl. After all, I’ve enjoyed these past two years. But I’m coming to Redmond.  <sub>[v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012)</sub>

> I was thinking the loveliest story about you and me, Diana.  <sub>[v1 c16 P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027)</sub>

> Oh, my mind agrees with you, Anne. But my soul remains doleful and uninspired. I’m always grubby and dingy on rainy nights.  <sub>[v3 c35 P35](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0035)</sub>

> I love Anne and I like Roy. Everybody says she is making a brilliant match, and even Mrs. Gardner thinks her charming now. It all sounds as if it were made in heaven, but I have my doubts. Make the most of that, Aunt Jamesina.  <sub>[v3 c36 P14](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0014)</sub>
